title: H-Meta-NAS five-repeat frozen target-side runtime audit
timer_scope: feasible candidate/population construction; candidate model construction; frozen architecture-indexed initialization restoration; two-generation population/mutation target architecture search; 50-step SGD target adaptation; validation evaluation; parameter/FLOP profiling retained from the frozen run; and final validation-only model selection. Excludes data construction, source/meta training, Check evaluation, held-out Test evaluation, verification, and reporting.

warmup.protocol: one untimed first-case warm-up, matching the existing repeated-runtime protocol

protocol_amendments.reason: The interrupted partial run stopped on a 1.49e-8 absolute check-MAE difference, identified as numerical precision noise.

protocol_amendments.note: The process was relaunched in the identical validated environment and resumed atomically from record 356/400.

criteria.evidence: Legacy formal-result protocol and frozen meta-bank hashes match the audited h_meta_nas_recovery_v1 artifacts.
Both use centers 980-999 crossed with H={1,4} and K={10,20}.
The legacy formal result contains no GPU/environment metadata.
Legacy timing begins after feasible-set/population construction and ends after selected-model reconstruction plus Check/Test evaluation.
Evolution/adaptation search is timed, but initial feasible-set and population construction occur before the legacy timer.
All 12 candidates receive the frozen 50-step SGD target adaptation inside the legacy timer.

criteria.criterion: validation evaluation and final selection included
criteria.evidence: Validation metrics and validation-only best-candidate selection occur inside the legacy timer.
The legacy timer starts only after the source meta-bank is built or loaded.
The legacy timer remains active while get_test_only and Test evaluation execute.

criteria.criterion: compatible CUDA synchronization and timing procedure
criteria.evidence: Per-candidate synchronization exists, but there is no synchronization immediately before the overall timer and no final synchronization after Check/Test work.

execution_events.boundary: after repeat 1 reached 80/80 and before repeat 2
execution_events.process_action: same Python process suspended and resumed

execution_events.handling: The first post-resume case and every other observation were retained without filtering.
